def solve(n, m, points, segments):
    # Sort points and segments for easier processing
    points.sort()
    segments.sort()

    # Initialize color array with -1 (unassigned)
    colors = [-1] * n

    # Try to assign colors to points
    for i in range(n):
        point = points[i]
        for j in range(m):
            li, ri = segments[j]
            if li <= point <= ri:
                if colors[i] == -1:
                    # Assign color based on the current segment
                    if (ri - li + 1) % 2 == 0:
                        # Even length segment, can be either color
                        colors[i] = 0
                    else:
                        # Odd length segment, assign color based on position
                        if (point - li) < (ri - point):
                            colors[i] = 0
                        else:
                            colors[i] = 1
                else:
                    # Check if the current assignment is valid
                    if (colors[i] == 0 and (ri - li + 1) % 2 != 0 and (point - li) >= (ri - point)) or \
                       (colors[i] == 1 and (ri - li + 1) % 2 != 0 and (point - li) < (ri - point)):
                        return "-1"
                break

    # Check if all segments satisfy the condition
    for li, ri in segments:
        red_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if colors[i] == 0 and li <= points[i] <= ri)
        blue_count = sum(1 for i in range(n) if colors[i] == 1 and li <= points[i] <= ri)
        if abs(red_count - blue_count) > 1:
            return "-1"

    return ' '.join(map(str, colors))
